decisions.reason: The original closure clause allowed arbitrary outside joining arcs: for one trivial strand an exterior knotted arc changes the closed knot. Fixed product closing arcs in a standard zero-framed unknotted solid torus now specify the operation, without changing exteriors, meridians, longitudes, basings or stacking.

The radial homotopy fixes E_L and lifts uniquely to a deck-equivariant strong deformation retract onto p^{-1}(E_L), not E_L. The subgroup and connectedness argument and the meridian-preserving Laurent-module isomorphism are sound. Corrected only the misleading title; Statement and proof are unchanged.

F2 attributed naturality to a supplier stating only exactness, and step 5.1 used it to identify both end maps. Removed that overclaim and proved the required identity directly: endpoint slice disks give the relative tube generators, and delta([j#d])=[boundary j#d]=[j# boundary d]. Added the exact relative-cycle and lift-and-boundary suppliers. All Statement clauses, the compatible-access caveat, and the punctured-disk diagram remain valid and unchanged.

The claimed separate result exists on the owning A page: thm-abelian-cover-chain-model-computes-alexander-module, steps 2.1–4.1, constructs and classifies the connected label cover; step 5.1 identifies exactly the algorithm face coefficients and proves boundary squared is zero; step 6.1 identifies H1 with A_L. The separate procedure-properties theorem proves termination. The triangle arrows match g01+g12+g20=0. No repair is warranted.
